read.en: The Nasdaq ADS rose 9.7% on Nov 11 to $142.25, trading $137.49–145.79. It is above the 5-day ($131.5) and 10-day ($141.0) and below the 30-day ($153.0); all three averages are falling (no 100-day or 200-day yet, 88 sessions). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, below zero, histogram nearly closed (a cross up is close); Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($162.66), and RSI is 46.6.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 11月11日上涨 9.7%，收于 $142.25，盘中区间 $137.49–145.79。股价位于 5 日（$131.5）和 10 日均线（$141.0）上方，30 日均线（$153.0）下方；三条均线均在下行（上市仅 88 个交易日，尚无 100、200 日均线）。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图接近收拢（临近上穿）；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$162.66），RSI 为 46.6。

read.en: The rally reclaimed $130.8–135.6, the 10-day and the $141.2 Nov 4 low, now support; the $145.79 high stalled under the $146.3–147.7 Nov 2 low and close. Resistance is $145.8–147.7, then $149.8–151.8 (Nov 3 low, Aug 24 low, Nov 4 high) and $153 (30-day). Support is $137.5–141.2, then $133.8–135.6 and $130.8–131.5 (Oct 22 low, 5-day). A close above $147.7 would target $150–153; below $137.5, $134–135.6.

read.en: SK hynix's latest Seoul close is ₩1,277,000, up from ₩1,212,000 in the previous read; the latest full session ranged ₩1,193,000–1,290,000. It is above the falling 5-day (₩1,206,800) and below the falling 10-day (₩1,298,200), 30-day (₩1,417,767) and 100-day (₩1,751,900) and the rising 200-day (₩1,517,265). MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 11, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 (₩1,506,250), and RSI is 43.1.
read.zh: SK 海力士首尔最新收盘价为 ₩1,277,000，高于上次解读的 ₩1,212,000；最近一个完整交易日区间为 ₩1,193,000–1,290,000。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（₩1,206,800）上方，下行的 10 日（₩1,298,200）、30 日（₩1,417,767）和 100 日均线（₩1,751,900）以及上行的 200 日均线（₩1,517,265）下方。MACD 于 11月11日上穿信号线，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（₩1,506,250），RSI 为 43.1。

read.en: The rebound cleared the ₩1,242,000–1,250,000 band (Nov 9 high, Jul 28 and Nov 4 lows), now support; the ₩1,290,000 high stopped under the 10-day. Resistance is ₩1,290,000–1,298,200 (latest high, 10-day), then ₩1,320,000 (Nov 4 high) and ₩1,373,000 (Aug 10 low). Support is ₩1,242,000–1,250,000, then ₩1,190,000–1,206,800 (Nov 9–10 lows, 5-day) and ₩1,171,000. A close above ₩1,298,200 would target ₩1.32–1.37 million; below ₩1,242,000, ₩1.19–1.21 million.

s.en: Nov 9 high ₩1,242,000; Jul 28 low ₩1,246,000; Nov 4 low ₩1,250,000, reclaimed
